title: Adreno-6xx WebGPU washed-out ghost (illustrated with product-scent-bottle)

input.note: STAND-IN input: the real Adreno-6xx phone capture is not in this repo. This photo is only a carrier for the documented alpha signature.

reproduction.method: assets reconstructed from the device report's documented signature; the phone photo itself is unavailable

observedProblem: The whole frame came out faint and translucent — a washed-out "ghost" — with no opaque foreground core (max alpha 0.41, mean 0.23), yet the photo visible everywhere at ~23% opacity.
suspectedCause: On a Qualcomm Adreno-6xx phone the WebGPU kernel returned a flat, low-confidence mask with no confident foreground (the documented driver/precision hypothesis in HARDWARE_TESTING.md §1/§8). The same flat shape appears whether or not a fallback ran, so it is the GPU kernel output itself, not the repo's alpha path.
